location_description: Wellington is a village just west of West Palm Beach in Palm Beach County and 66 mi (106 km) north of Miami.  As of 2019, the city had a population of 65,398 according to U.S. Census Bureau estimates, making it the most populous village in the state. It is the fifth largest municipality in Palm Beach County by population.
